item.title: KeNHA Announces Indefinite Closure of Crucial Bridge After Governor's Warning
item.description: KeNHA revealed the bridge, which connects to the main town, would be closed until further notice due to safety concerns.

item.title: NTSA Gives Major Update on Design & Supply of New Digital Driving Licences
item.description: The latest update comes hardly two months after the cabinet approved the production of the new digital licences through a PPP framework.

item.title: KeNHA Issues Eviction Notice to Traders Along Thika Superhighway
item.description: This comes days after KeNHA spearheaded market demolitions in Githurai, with another fresh eviction notice targeted towards temporary market structures at Roysambu, both situated along Thika Superhigway

item.title: Govt Announces Salary Changes for Some Employees
item.description: With the February payroll now reflecting the adjustments, attention is likely to shift to other counties yet to confirm implementation of the revised salary structure.

item.title: NTSA On The Spot Over 70,000 Missing Number Plates Funds
item.description: According to the association, the shortage is being blamed on delayed funding from the National Treasury to NTSA, which has left suppliers unpaid and unable to deliver raw materials for plate production.

item.title: MPs Order Freeze of All New Projects Amid Ksh 120 Billion Gap
item.description: Speaking during a committee meeting on February 23, the members of parliament (MPs) directed the Ministry to prioritise completion of ongoing and delayed projects.

item.title: KeNHA Unveils Plans to Upgrade 815Kms of Roads in Nyanza and Western Kenya
item.description: The World Bank has already committed funds to the consultancy works, with the initial phase set to begin with the laying of fibre optic cables.

item.title: KDF Announces Mass Auction of Vehicles With Ksh50,000 Deposit
item.description: The KDF mass auction offers a rare opportunity for Kenyans to acquire vehicles and equipment directly from the Ministry of Defence at lower prices.

item.title: Treasury Proposes Another Fund for Children
item.description: The establishment of the fund comes months after the government formally announced the establishment of the National Infrastructure Fund (NIF).

item.title: Kenya Met Lists Counties to Receive Intense Rainfall and Thunderstorms This Week
item.description: The Kenya Meteorological Department stressed the need for Kenyans to remain vigilant and ensure that they refrain from crossing flooded rivers and roads.
